description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryDecorator class which acts as a decorator for the EmployeeSalary entity, providing methods to set associated entities such as Employee, PayPeriod, PayGrade, and CurrencyType by their IDs. It uses traits and references to other entities within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeSalary entity that provides methods to modify the associated entities via their IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeSalary instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity associated with the salary by employee number.

methods.name: setPayPeriodById
methods.description: Sets the PayPeriod entity associated with the salary by pay period ID.

methods.name: setPayGradeById
methods.description: Sets the PayGrade entity associated with the salary by pay grade ID.

methods.name: setCurrencyTypeById
methods.description: Sets the CurrencyType entity associated with the salary by currency type ID.
